targets.evidence_quote:
Using a data set of French SME owners, we tried to replicate and extend the 
findings of Yu et al. (2018).
targets.outcome_quote:
Looking at the subdimensions of ADHD, the results of our analyses are 
mostly in line with the findings of Yu et al. (2018). Similar to Yu et al., we 
found a positive association between hyperactivity and EO.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The positive hyperactivity–EO relationship and the absence of an attention-deficit–total EO relationship agree with Yu. Additional EO subdimension analyses extend rather than contradict the earlier tested findings. The footnote explicitly identifies the 2018 Academy of Management Proceedings version as the replication basis rather than the forthcoming 2020 article.
